title: STRM mapping entry
description: One set-theory relationship mapping from an owned master control to one external framework requirement. Drafted by AI, validated and approved by a human via pull request.

master_control_id.description: Owned control ID as defined in 02-controls/control-library.yaml (e.g. AAT-01, PRI-03.13).

external_framework.description: Framework key or display name of the external framework being mapped (e.g. iso42001).

external_requirement_id.description: Requirement/clause identifier exactly as the external framework writes it (e.g. A.2.2). Never invented.

relationship_type.description: Set-theory relationship of the owned control to the external requirement.

rationale.description: One-line rationale tying the control behavior to the clause.

status.description: Drafts are pending until a human approves by merge.
